mapper.select: SELECT PICK_ID FROM OHT_CASE where DATA_TIME between #{begTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND case_status=3 group by PICK_ID

select pick_id as userId,avg(take_time) as takeTime,count(level1) as level1,count(level2) as level2,count(level3) as level3 from ( select a.pick_id,a.case_type,a.take_time,b.case_id as level1,c.case_id as level2,d.case_id as level3 from (select pick_id,case_id,case_type,((to_date(pcomp_time,'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi:ss')-to_date('1970-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd'))*86400 - to_number(substr(tz_offset(sessiontimezone),1,3))*3600-pick_time) as take_time from oht_case where data_time between #{begTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and case_type=#{caseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pick_id = #{pickId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and case_status=3 and pcomp_type is not null) a left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=1 and task_status=1) b on (a.case_id = b.case_id) left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=2 and task_status=1) c on (a.case_id = c.case_id) left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=3 and task_status=1) d on (a.case_id = d.case_id) ) group by pick_id

select to_number(substr(data_time,12,2)) as hour,count(case_type) as hold_num,avg(wait_time) as waitTime,count(level1) as level1,count(level2) as level2,count(level3) as level3 from ( select a.data_time,a.pick_id,a.case_type,a.wait_time,b.case_id as level1,c.case_id as level2,d.case_id as level3 from (select data_time,pick_id,case_id,case_type,wait_time from oht_case where data_time between #{begTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and case_type=#{caseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and case_status!=-1 ) a left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=1 and task_status=1) b on (a.case_id = b.case_id) left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=2 and task_status=1) c on (a.case_id = c.case_id) left join (select case_id from oht_case_task where task_level=3 and task_status=1) d on (a.case_id = d.case_id) ) group by substr(data_time,12,2)
